source_of_truth: ILLUSTRATION_PROMPTS.md contains the fully self-contained paste-ready prompts.
constraints: Generated scene backdrops and symbolic paintings are optional planned assets and are not present in the runtime.
Existing code-native morality-*.svg diagrams are authored argument content and must remain separate and unchanged.
Do not use generated imagery as evidence, a truth score, a reconstruction, or a factual claim.
Render using the approved master image as a visual reference after the master is selected.
Use ts_ms as the authoritative epoch-millisecond manifest timestamp.
No image may imply empirical evidence, recreate a research experiment or abuse, sensationalize a victim, or demonize a realist, critic or dissenter.
No generated painting may replace or modify its paired authored SVG diagram.
